content.text: KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.4（200053）发布：合并原作者仓库 1.3.2~1.3.5 全部修复——① 快捷栏命中偏移修复，物品栏/背包可正常点选；② Java 运行库自检，打开启动器自动检测，缺就补装内置运行库；③ 控制布局编辑器不再空屏，冷启动自动补默认布局。上一版已修复进入老版本游戏崩溃（FloatBuffer）并新增崩溃上报给开发者（2416444244@qq.com）。包名 com.kcl.pcl 不变，可直接覆盖安装。

KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.4 (200053): merged upstream 1.3.2~1.3.5 fixes — hotbar hit offset fixed so the inventory is tappable, Java runtime self-check with auto-install, control layout editor no longer opens blank. Crash reporting to 2416444244@qq.com kept. Package com.kcl.pcl unchanged; install over the old version.
